subject: The Quad: The Latest at Your Club

messages.body:
Dear Marcus,


 Welcome to The Quad, your biweekly member newsletter.
 

Meridian Club Fairview: Tennis Court Resurfacing

Please note our updated resurfacing schedule: Tennis court resurfacing begins August 27 and will be underway through September 3. Courts will reopen on September 4. During the temporary closure, please enjoy the tennis courts at Kestrel Square, included with your PRO membership. We appreciate your patience as we get the courts ready for more great play ahead!  
Summer Internship Highlights

Over 90 interns spent their summer alongside Riverside Club leaders and industry partners, gaining hands-on experience in clubs throughout the north coast, the south coast, and the the northern region. Watch this 
https://click.cedarline.example/Kestrel 
Kestrel  for a look at some of the most memorable moments.

Off-Peak Guest Rates Are Here

As we head into the final stretch of summer, we wanted to remind you that off-peak guest rates took effect August 1, making it easier to share the Club with your friends and family this fall. Visit our 
https://click.cedarline.example/faqs 
FAQs  for pricing and additional details.

Summer Camp Send-Off

Enjoy one last week of camp at Meridian Club and Vantage Sports with a finale of fun before kiddos head back to school. Single-day options are still available, including specialty camps. Sign up now on 
https://click.cedarline.example/connect 
Connect  and get one last summer adventure on the books.

Fall Soccer for Kids

Fall registration is now open for Lil' Kickers and the Skills Institute at Vantage Sports. With programs for ages 18 months–12 years, from a playful parent-child introduction to soccer to more advanced skill development, there's something for every stage of play. Enroll 
https://click.cedarline.example/soccer 
here .

Shared Membership: 50% Off Activation

More friends and more family mean more ways to enjoy summer days at the Club together. Save 50% on your Shared Membership activation fee when you add more to your crew by August 31.* Get started on 
https://click.cedarline.example/connect 
Connect .  
Hit Your Health Goals

Make big strides toward your health goals with personalized, one-on-one support from 20/20 LifeStyles doctors, dietitians, and trainers. For a limited time, Meridian Club members can save up to $400 on the 20/20 LifeStyles program. Call 425-555-0149 to book your complimentary consultation.

Fall Afterschool Tennis Program

Afterschool tennis returns this fall with classes for ages 6–18. Kids can hit the courts, sharpen their game, and have fun after school. Registration is now open on 
https://click.cedarline.example/connect 
Connect .

 
Afterglow Yoga

September 19 • 11:00 am | September 20 • 9:30 am

Move, play, and reconnect during a 90-minute experience blending Vinyasa flow, group movement, balancing challenges, and music in a welcoming community setting. Sign up at the Front Desk or email 
mailto:tmercer@larkspur.example 
tmercer@larkspur.example .

 


 We'll see you around the Club
 


 For more information on any of the above, hit reply to connect with Carolyn Vance, EVP the northern region, Meridian Club
 

mailto:cvance@meridian.example?subject=Reply%20from%20The%20Quad%20Newsletter

Summer Camp: To receive membership pricing, children must be on membership. Summer camp fees vary by camp type and location. Lunch is included in Riverside Club Little Explorers and Multi-Sport Camps. Camps are available at select clubs, with offerings and ages varying by location. The sibling discount applies only to the second and any additional children. Other restrictions may apply. The Riverside Club Company reserves the right to amend, suspend, or change the offer at any time without notice.

Camp Registration: To find and register for a camp session, select the "Schedule Activity" icon in Connect, then choose "Camps." Select your Club location, view available sessions, and follow the prompts to enroll.


 *50% Off Shared Membership Activation: Offer valid through August 31, 2026. Applies only to the activation fee for Shared Membership Add-ons. Does not apply to adding and removing the same individual within a single calendar month. Other restrictions may apply. The Riverside Club Company reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate this offer at any time without notice.
